notes.title: Update - 29.04.2023
notes.notes:
Added 10 new sceneries
 Added models of heroes for first three missions

notes.title: Update - 18.09.2022
notes.notes:
Added bonuses - with completed missions in various difficulties you get the option to activate bonuses - increases in speed, health, attack or defense. But beware, they also have a negative side to them
 Added 12 new sceneries for you to work in - bringing up to a total of 30 sceneries

notes.title: Update - 27.02.2022
notes.notes:
Added 7 more sceneries created with HDRI (photos suited for VR viewing.... or exercising)
Added exercise mode - do specific movements in your own pace to the music of your choosing

notes.title: Update - 10.10.2021
notes.notes:
Random scenery toggle on each new song in training
Exploding animation for spheres
Freestyle and freestyle 180 mode for training
3 new missions

notes.title: Update - 11.07.2021
notes.notes:
"before start" window, so you will get info about what to actually do in the game
added checking of velocity for normal spheres - so you cannot simply "hold hands high" and catch spheres without any movement
walls are now partially transparent - so you can see if there are spheres behind them
changed "coin" sound for box hitting - let's face it, it was too annoying

notes.title: Update - 12.06.2021
notes.notes:
small optimizations and lighting changes
added some spaceships so you would not feel alone in space

notes.title: Update - 15.05.2021
notes.notes:
added power mode, so impact power will be relevant for play
 added max 1 sphere per beat switch if you prefer not to use both your arms at the same time
 added experimental beat generation based on actual beats - to test against your custom songs, delete them from app and add them again
 added level-up window, so you won't forget to spend your new skillpoints
 added some tooltips, if you feel lost
